# Consumer handoff

The objective is to prepare the consumer handoff across teams over multiple sessions.
Scope includes inventory, consumer implementation, synthetic endpoint integration, operational handoff, and a production rollout decision boundary.
Changing product behavior or making real infrastructure calls is excluded.
